verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce platform, but the evidence shows Visa Intelligent Commerce's core (agent token provisioning, instruction validation, VisaNet controls) runs only as Visa-hosted, credential-gated APIs. Two things do run locally but do not count: the open Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation is a merchant-side verification sample, and the MCP toolkit is a client to Visa's hosted APIs. Neither is a self-hostable version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
